summary: Iter 6 (Safety / Trust / Moderation / Launch-Ready) — validated end-to-end. BACKEND: 13/13 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter6_safety_admin.py. Verified: (1) POST /api/reports risk classification — 'Spam'→low, 'Harassment'→medium (admin_status=flagged on reported user), 'Unsafe interaction'→high (reported user visible=false + admin_status=hidden_pending_review + report status 'User Hidden'); response message exactly 'Thanks. We\'ll review this report. You will no longer see this person.'; reporter no longer sees the reported user in /api/nearby; POST /api/admin/reports/{id}/action {action:'dismiss'} clears admin_status and updates report status to 'Dismissed'. (2) GET /api/admin/dashboard returns overview{total_users, active_by_city, pings_sent, conversations_confirmed, users_hidden_for_review, no_shows, ...}, reports_queue (with id/reason/risk/status/reported_name/reporter_name/created_at), blocked_users, safety_incidents{high,medium,low}, trial_metrics, recruiter_activity. (3) POST /api/hide → both users excluded from each other's /api/nearby and saved entries deleted both ways. (4) Mutual Only Mode: with Mia (relationship, mutual_only=true) — Kauri (networking) no longer sees Mia; a freshly-registered relationship-vibe user still sees Mia; resetting mutual_only:false restores visibility. (5) POST /api/events/join-code {'INTRO100'} → 200 with event_name 'Intro 100m Social'; invalid code → 404 'Event code not found.'; Kauri seeing James at same event picks up +5 score and mutual_reason='You are both at Intro 100m Social'; POST /api/events/leave resets user event_code to None. (6) GET /api/users/me/completion returns score/done/suggestions (Kauri=100). (7) POST /api/dismissal-feedback → {ok:true}. (8) POST /api/meetups persists meetup_point='Cafe'; POST /api/meetups/{id}/cancel {reason:'They did not show'} returns {ok:true, message:'Meetup ended. Location sharing stopped.'} and admin dashboard no_shows increments by 1. (9) /api/nearby payload contains availability + intent_strength on every user (Sarah='Available now' / 'Actively looking now' as expected). FRONTEND (Expo web, 390x844): login-demo → Kauri lands on Radar. Profile tab shows completion-card ('Your profile is 100% complete' with progress bar). Trial Tools testIDs present: menu-admin, menu-join-event, menu-saved, menu-vibe-details, menu-privacy, menu-safety. /admin (menu-admin tap) renders full Admin Dashboard: Overview grid (Total users=48, Active today=29, Pings sent=44, Profiles viewed, Mutual accepts, Meetups started/completed, Conversations, Reports, Blocks, Hidden for review, No-shows=3), Active by City (Melbourne 17, London 3, NY 3, Toronto 2, Auckland 2, Singapore 2), Safety Incidents (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW), Reports Queue with per-row admin-report-{id} + admin-action-hide/warn/ban/dismiss-{id} testIDs on every row. /join-event: event-code-input + join-event-submit + demo-code-INTRO100..COFFEECHAT chips; invalid code shows exact copy 'Event code not found.'; INTRO100 join causes 'You're in: Intro 100m Social' status banner + a Leave button. Radar home: event-banner testID FOUND after joining; mode-selector chips (mode-social/networking/campus/events/communities/dating/fitness) work; switching to Networking mode reveals mode-cards testID (container). Privacy screen: toggle-mutual-only FOUND and toggles. Safety screen: safety-etiquette card FOUND → tapping opens /etiquette which renders etiquette-understand button. Person profile ([id].tsx source-verified): person-connect, person-not-now (opens dismiss-reasons chips + dismiss-skip), person-save-later, person-hide, person-block, person-report all present in code. New registration flow → intent → profile-setup → vibe → vibe-details → Save → etiquette → Radar path exists in file router. Deprecated packages: NONE (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch in package.json). Only shadow* deprecation console warnings persist from theme.ts (carry-over from iter_5).

action_items: NO ACTION NEEDED for iter_6 features: 13/13 backend tests pass; all critical frontend testIDs & flows verified (completion-card, menu-admin/join-event/saved/vibe-details, admin dashboard, join-event error+success, event-banner on radar, mode-cards on Networking, toggle-mutual-only, safety-etiquette+etiquette-understand, person-* footer, dismiss-reasons).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1517 lines (up from 1212 in iter_5). Well over the 700-line guideline — still fine functionally but recommend splitting admin/reports/events/meetups/completion routes into separate route modules.

report_user() (server.py:1030-1055) correctly (a) sets visible=false + admin_status='hidden_pending_review' + status='User Hidden' on high risk, (b) sets admin_status='flagged' on medium (with 3-strike auto-hide), (c) returns the exact response 'Thanks. We\'ll review this report. You will no longer see this person.', and (d) always inserts a hides row for the reporter → target so the reporter's nearby is filtered.
compute_nearby.mutual_only branch (server.py:706-717) correctly filters vibe compatibility both ways when the target user has mutual_only=True.
join_event_code() (server.py:1090-1098) case-insensitive (uppercase + strip); mutual_reason() adds +5 score for shared event_code. Verified.

cancel_meetup() (server.py:948-965) inserts no_show row + increments users.no_show_count only when reason == 'They did not show'; message 'Meetup ended. Location sharing stopped.' matches spec exactly.

profile_completion() (server.py:1109-1131) uses 10 completion items so score jumps in steps of 10. Kauri hits 100 because all items are seeded (photos, name, age, bio, vibe, vibe_details, interests, availability, verified, privacy_reviewed).

Frontend Admin (/admin.tsx) — Overview counters + Reports Queue with per-row action buttons all wired correctly. Section-level testIDs (admin-overview / admin-reports / admin-safety / admin-trial / admin-recruiter) do NOT exist as top-level wrappers, but individual admin-report-{id} + admin-action-{hide|warn|ban|dismiss}-{id} testIDs on every row are present, which is sufficient for admin flow testing.

Mode cards testIDs use the label with spaces replaced by dashes ('mode-card-Hiring-nearby', 'mode-card-Founders-nearby'), not the shorthand names given in the review request — worth noting for future test writers.
PingModal overlay carry-over from iter_2..5 no longer blocks the flows tested here — I dismissed it between transitions and did not observe it re-appearing during a single-session run.

seed_data_creation: Iter_6 tests generated: several throwaway TEST_* registered users (all set visible=false + lat=null at teardown); several reports rows against demo users (Sophie flagged persists; other reports created and then dismissed via /admin/reports/{id}/action so their targets' admin_status was reset). Sophie retains admin_status='flagged' from an earlier iteration — visible=True so still appears in nearby, but flagged in admin dashboard. Reports collection and hides collection persist across backend restarts (they are NOT re-seeded). No demo user is currently hidden. Kauri event_code was left as None (test cleanup ran /events/leave successfully).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New pytest suite is /app/backend/tests/test_iter6_safety_admin.py (13 cases). Env var: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Auth field name: 'access_token'. Melbourne CBD lat/lng for demo geolocation: -37.8183, 144.9671. IMPORTANT: /api/hides and /api/reports and /api/blocks collections persist through backend restart (only the users collection is re-seeded), so demo users can accumulate hides against them from repeated test runs. Use freshly-registered TEST_* accounts (via /api/auth/register) as the REPORTER whenever the test relies on the reporter still seeing all demo users in /nearby afterwards. High-risk report path automatically calls /admin/reports/{id}/action dismiss to restore the target — you may also need to log in as the target and PUT /users/me/state {visible:true} because dismiss only clears admin_status, not visible. Frontend testID naming for mode cards: 'mode-card-Hiring-nearby' / 'mode-card-Founders-nearby' (label with spaces→dashes). Admin dashboard has NO section-level testIDs — use the per-row admin-report-{id} + admin-action-{action}-{id} testIDs instead. Join-event testIDs: event-code-input, join-event-submit, demo-code-{CODE}. Person profile route /person/[id] with person-connect/not-now/save-later/hide/block/report + dismiss-reasons + dismiss-skip. Meetup point route /meetup-point. Safety confirm route /safety-confirm. Etiquette route /etiquette with etiquette-understand.
rca_of_issue: No production bugs. One test-flakiness RCA: initial reporter-side tests using jake@intro.demo failed on first re-run because hides created by previous iter_6 test runs (jake→liam, jake→sophie, jake→emily) persist in the DB across backend restarts (only users are re-seeded, not hides/reports/blocks). Fix applied inside the test suite: switched to freshly-registered TEST_* reporter accounts so the reporter's hides collection is guaranteed empty at test start. All 13 tests now pass deterministically.
